set.tovw: Lead grade C (treasure thread): local second account, farm placed
set.pl: Old farm house mark, SE¼ sec. 14 T105N R23W, Byron Twp (1896 Waseca atlas), a few miles NW of New Richland
pinev: Parcel-level: 1896 Ogle Waseca County atlas house mark in SE¼ sec. 14 T105N R23W (Byron Twp); a 1938 aerial shows a farmstead and tree grove there (about 250 m).
set.st: June 1905: a stranger from Indiana boarded with the farmer and, with his leave, dug numerous holes in the grove near an old house long said to be haunted, after about $15,000 thought cached in early days by thieves; an old settler said the neighbourhood was once a rendezvous for horse thieves running between northern Iowa and Hastings. He found nothing and left. Private farmland: permission. Pin is on the 1896 house mark, not the spot itself.
set.t: The digger found nothing, so whatever was cached may still be there. Check the grove around the old house site on the 1938 aerial. Access: private farmland, ask permission.
src: Ogle, Plat Book of Waseca County (1896)
